environment.description: Same Node.js 18 Express application packaged as a container image and deployed as an AWS Lambda function with a Function URL configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The function URL's resource-based policy does NOT include a principal grant for unauthenticated access (no lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType condition allowing NONE). Callers must present valid SigV4-signed requests with credentials from an IAM identity that has lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl permission. The Lambda execution role has only basic CloudWatch Logs permissions. The function is configured with 128MB memory and 10-second timeout. A resource policy explicitly denies invocation from principal '*' unless aws:PrincipalOrgID matches the organization. CloudTrail logs all InvokeFunctionUrl events. Note: the in-memory rate limiter is ineffective in Lambda (cold starts reset state), but the IAM auth gate prevents external unauthenticated traffic from reaching the regex evaluation paths.

config.iam_permissions_required: lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl on the specific function ARN
